page.summary: Index of established product requirements and founder decisions in docs/product, docs/decisions and audit/decisions, each with source and date. Covers the trust modes, one subscription across six apps, plan catalog, gated paid upgrades, mobile decisions of November 2026, unresolved choices, and where documents contradict each other or the code. Read-only; nothing was run.

sections.heading: How to read this page
sections.markdown:
This page collects what the repository records as product requirements and founder decisions. It is an index for citing, not a spec.

**Basis tags.** [code] means I opened the file at that line. [requirement] means a project document states it. [inferred] is my reasoning from code. [proposed] is my suggestion. [unknown] means not established. Nothing here is [executed]: no document I read records a real run of these requirements, and I ran nothing.

**Two statuses.** Implementation status is whether code exists and is connected. Verification status is whether anyone ran it. This page gives only implementation status, and only where quick to check. The surface matrix says a Present cell has been located, not exercised (file:docs/product/surface-feature-matrix.md, header).

**Precedence.** AGENTS.md section 2 ranks code above prose. Where a document disagrees with code, code wins and the document is listed under Contradictions.

**Handles.** REQ-* names are my stable short names for requirements. D-yyyy-mm-dd-nn are the founder's own decision IDs.

| Topic | Owner file | Status line |
|---|---|---|
| Product definition | file:docs/product/definition.md | Current, 2026-11-19 |
| Long PRD | file:docs/product/requirements.md | see its section 27 |
| Suite thesis, sync boundary | file:docs/product/suite.md | Current |
| Commercial model | file:docs/product/commercial.md | Current, 2026-11-11 |

| Feature by surface matrix | file:docs/product/surface-feature-matrix.json (rendered to .md) | Generated, 2026-09-20 |

| Open founder calls | file:audit/decisions/founder-decisions.md, open-questions.md, founder-actions.md | open lists |

I read the product and decision files and the audit/decisions headings. I did not read all of founder-actions.md (about 106 KB) or wire-or-cut.md (about 976 KB); I read their section lists only. I did not read the full text of competitive-guidance.md (76 KB) beyond its opening and its surface inventory.

key_facts.fact: Plan IDs are local-only, byok, free, basic, pro, max, max_15x, team, team_premium, enterprise; public labels differ (pro is Premium, max_15x is Ultra).
Local plan and BYOK plan cost zero; isFreeOfChargePlanTier covers local-only, byok and free.
Entitlement resolves to free unless subscription status is active or trialing.
One AGI account has one effective subscription across all six surfaces; surfaces never create a second entitlement.
Mobile v1 sells nothing in the app: nativePurchases is false.
Paid upgrades are gated by a runtime operator flag, an env override AGI_BILLING_WAITLIST_OPEN=1, or a beta_redemptions row; unreadable flag means closed.
Managed Free is public alpha after sign-in since 2026-06-27; AGI_MANAGED_COMPUTE_PRIVATE_BETA is only a kill-switch.
Local mode never silently reaches BYOK or Cloud; the typed Local contract has cloudEgressAllowed false and failover refuse.
Mobile has no BYOK mode in v1.
Individual plans are monthly only; Team keeps yearly. Decided 2026-09-27.
Electron is the public Desktop; a 2026-10-24 amendment says Tauri also ships as a second public app, name undecided.
Serial surface order is Website, Mobile, Desktop, Chrome, CLI, VS Code (founder 2026-09-21).
Surface feature matrix today: 190 present, 106 absent, 60 unverified, 1 partial over 51 features; Present means located, not exercised.
Two continuity domains: Account Cloud (Web, Mobile Cloud, Desktop Cloud, eligible Chrome) and Host Developer (Desktop Code, CLI, VS Code).
On mobile in Local mode only device-scoped destinations are shown; unclassified screens count as cloud.
Model-improvement training switches (chats, voice) are decided opt-in and off by default on 2026-11-13, pending lawyer review; nothing uses customer content for training today.
Model picker on mobile: Auto only, with Instant, Economy, Images, Files filters from the catalog; web and desktop keep Instant, Best, Economy.
Managed turns that cross a usage window finish on the plan; monthly allowance is a hard edge (2026-10-25).
Per-seat credits, two-seat minimum for Team (decision 29, 2026-10-22).
US-only managed data and inference, on a region-neutral design.
Model IDs may be literals only in the generated catalog; defaults reference family slots.
Competitive guidance: ChatGPT and Claude primary references; parity measured by outcomes and continuity, not label matching.
No release has been shown to have run as of 2026-11-11: surface workflows have no runs, one draft release, store availability unverified.
A no-sales-before-2027-01-01 decision and an 18-and-over rule appear only in owner memory, not in any repository document I read.
